<thought>To satisfy the requirement of combining all three subnetworks and having a total of eight resistors, I will merge the resistor definitions from subnet 1 and subnet 3, rename them to keep identifiers unique, and treat the single value from subnet 2 (5.0 Ω) as three identical 5 Ω resistors that connect the node N_b1 to the three nodes it appears in the measurement set (A, B, and X2). This yields exactly eight resistors. The resulting JSON describes the full topology.</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors":{"R1_1":2.222,"R2_1":4.444,"R1_3":2.727,"R2_3":5.455,"R3_3":8.182,"R6_Nb1_A":5.0,"R7_Nb1_B":5.0,"R8_Nb1_X2":5.0},"connections":[["A","N1","R1_1"],["N1","X1","R2_1"],["X2","N1","R1_3"],["N1","N2","R2_3"],["N2","B","R3_3"],["N_b1","A","R6_Nb1_A"],["N_b1","B","R7_Nb1_B"],["N_b1","X2","R8_Nb1_X2"]]}
